errors.evidence: The description incorrectly uses the symbol "Δ" (Delta) for the series name. The legend in the figure uses the symbol "▲" (filled triangle). The correct label is "▲ Accuracy".
The description incorrectly uses the symbol "Δ" (Delta) for the series name. The legend in the figure uses the symbol "▲" (filled triangle). The correct label is "▲ Accuracy".

The description states that the value for the “Δ Accuracy” series rises to a range of 0.24–0.28 at x-values of 0.82–0.83. However, the plot shows the values are approximately 0.28 (at x=0.82) and 0.23 (at x=0.83). The stated range of 0.24-0.28 incorrectly excludes the value at 0.83.
